Maya created the color and symbol system used by the
[Neighborhood Atlas](/note/projects/neighborhood_atlas/neighborhood_atlas). Her
working rules live in [Design principles](/note/notes/design_principles), and her
open questions are captured in [August studio notes](/note/notes/meeting_notes_august).

occurrences.context: Start with Alex, follow the direct edge to Maya, then open Maya's link to Sofia.
Participants: Alex, Jamie, Maya, and Noah.
Maya Singh turned the research into a visual language, while Noah Williams built a lightweight data pipeline.
- [x] Remove identifying details - [x] Pull memorable observations - [ ] Cluster observations by theme - [ ] Add uncertainties to the data dictionary - [ ] Share a short readout with Maya
